notCaptured.reason: The Closing section (section.outro, data-zone=outro) renders three text Buttons (LinkedIn, Discord, Twitch) and no icon-button social row; a DOM query for links inside it returns only those three CTAs. Nothing was fabricated.

notCaptured.visualId: hero social pill with visible labels
notCaptured.reason: The stylesheet defines a 42px-high pill with a visible <span> label, but a later unconditional .hs{width:46px;height:46px;padding:0;justify-content:center} rule plus .hs span{display:none} overrides it at every width, so the labelled pill never renders. Only the 44px narrow-width variants differ.
The ghost hover is not part of the round-outline delta and is already covered by the approved v0.1 board (VIS-01, ghost hover row).

limits: The captures show the web's local .hs/.icon-btn styles, which are flatter than the design-system recipe (flat 3% fill, no sheen, no edge/elevation, hardcoded focus ring). They are evidence for the role and the delta, not approved expected design for the IconButton recipe.

pulso-source.html is a template with Jinja image placeholders in the tips rail; those images fail to load, but they are outside every crop. The carousel counter shows live JavaScript state (03 / 10) rather than its initial value.
The reveal system starts every [data-reveal] node at opacity 0; the script forces the revealed state so the crop is not a pre-reveal capture. No source file is modified.

In the /tmp harness document.fonts.check('600 13px Barlow') returned false while the condensed 600 check returned true; the .meta captions under the VIS-07/VIS-08 circles may therefore use a synthesized or fallback weight. The circles and glyphs are SVG and are unaffected.

VIS-07 shows a 48x48px painted border box because .eg-icon-btn--outline declares width:46px with content-box sizing; the live hero row renders 46x46px because pulso-source.html sets a global border-box reset. Both numbers are reported in the spec; neither is a token value.
Browser images do not verify behavior, accessibility, keyboard or focus behavior.

PNG bytes can differ between runs of the same script (scroll-dependent compositing); the hashes above are of the files stored in this folder and must be re-verified with sha256sum before linking them in any published comment.

approval.reference: Pending: the owner approves or declines these captures as supporting evidence for IconButton v0.3 in issue #57. The captures are source evidence and grant no expected-design approval.
